I'm tracing the path starting at (9,7) moving diagonally up-left, checking each cell along the way to see whether it's empty before continuing the simulation.

Whenever the path hits a boundary I bounce the direction: at column 0 the horizontal direction flips, and at row 0 the vertical direction flips. I keep moving through empty cells until reaching (4,6), which holds a piece, so the path stops one cell earlier at (3,5) — that's where the marker lands.
